title: Minute-by-minute Launch Ops Checklist & KPI Log
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact, minute-by-minute operational checklist and KPI log designed for small-batch launches and rapid ramp scenarios. The doc is intentionally terse so launch leads and on-call engineers can run to it at T-48h through T+1h without flipping between pages.

Scope and intent:
- Covers final 48 hours before public rollout through first 60 minutes post-traffic shift.
- Tracks a small prioritized set of KPIs (latency, error rate, cost burn, throughput, model quality signal).
- Includes explicit escalation and rollback triggers with owner assignments.
- Designed to be pasted into the launch Slack channel and the Launch Command doc.

Primary owners:
- Launch lead: Ava Chen (product-ops)
- SRE escalation: Diego Morales (site-reliability)
- Product QA: Priya Nair (product-hosted-api)
- Console/telemetry: Liam O'Connor (observability)

Baseline KPI snapshot (pre-launch):
- Token cost per 1k (baseline): $X.XX -> Target commit: <= $X.XX
- API P95 latency (baseline): 210ms -> Target: <= 250ms under expected load
- Error rate (5xx) baseline: 0.12% -> Trigger: >0.5% sustained 3m
- Throughput (req/s) baseline: 1800 -> Ramp target: 2500
- Quality regressions (eval set): 0.8% fail rate -> Alert if >1.5%

T-48 hours (checklist)
- Confirm final model and quantization artifacts are tagged and immutable (owner: Launch lead).
- Update rollout policy in Console: canary -> staged traffic lanes (owner: product-ops).
- Confirm Dedicated capacity reservations and burst policy (owner: infra).
- Run quick smoke test: sample prompts (10) across regions, confirm latency & logits (owner: product QA).
- Post short plan in #launch-command: timeline, on-call rotations, escalation tree (owner: Launch lead).
- Run cost snapshot for predicted 6-hour peak and confirm finance alignment (owner: finance gate).

T-8 hours (checklist)
- Final telemetry dashboards (live) created and pinned: model_latency.p95, api_errors.5xx, cost.token_burn (owner: observability).
- Canary traffic allocation strategy locked (percentages + time windows).
- Notify key stakeholders: support rotation, CS standby, sales standby.
- Validate fallback routes are configured (alternate smaller model, different region) and test-fail them once to ensure failover works (owner: infra/SRE).

T-1 hour (checklist)
- Confirm Slack alerting rules match thresholds and escalation steps (owner: observability).
- Run final end-to-end test with 100 concurrent synthetic users, check P95 and error rate (owner: SRE).
- Confirm logging/trace sampling rates are elevated for first 60m post-launch.
- Freeze non-critical merges and CI runs (owner: release-engineering).

T-15 minutes
- Standup in #launch-command: 3-min status, confirm readiness flags green (owners report: Launch lead, SRE, Observability, Product QA).
- Snapshot KPIs and upload to the Tracker (copy paste block below).
- All hands on-call alerted and acknowledged.

Launch window (0 -> +60 minutes) minute-by-minute cadence (high level):
- 0m: Shift initial 2% traffic to new model variant. Confirm immediate health (P95, errors).
- 5m: If health OK, shift to 5%. If any trigger hit (see triggers section) pause and escalate.
- 15m: If OK, move to 20% and keep for 20 minutes.
- 35m: If OK, move to 50% for 10 minutes. If OK after that, proceed to full 100% per rollout plan.
- During each step: Observability posts a KPI snapshot at +5m and +30m and tags SRE/Launch lead.

KPI snapshot block (to paste into tracker/Slack):
- timestamp: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mmZ
- rollout_percent: 2 / 5 / 20 / 50 / 100
- api_p95_ms: 210 (example)
- api_p50_ms: 80
- error_rate_5xx_pct: 0.06
- model_quality_regressions_pct: 0.9
- token_cost_per_1k_usd: 0.12
- active_replicas: 12
- region_health: us-east=ok, eu-west=ok

Automated and manual triggers (do not ignore):
- AUTO ROLLBACK: sustained error rate 5xx > 0.8% over 3m OR P95 > 600ms over 5m.
- MANUAL PAUSE: model_quality_regressions increase > 0.7 percentage points vs baseline (product QA calls).
- ESCALATE TO ENG-LEAD: if token cost per 1k spikes > 2x forecasted in 5m window.

Escalation ladder (contact sequence):
1) On-call SRE -> Diego Morales
2) Launch lead -> Ava Chen
3) Infra lead -> (pager)
4) Head of product ops -> Priya Nair

Post-mortem & early learning (T+1h -> T+72h)
- T+1h: initial incidents logged, brief update to stakeholders with raw KPI snapshots and decision log.
- T+24h: preliminary incident review and small action list (who will fix what in next 48h).
- T+72h: complete runbook: root cause, metrics analysis, follow-up owners, and model-quality regression cohort.

Quick reference: checklist matrix (single-line items for copy/paste)
- confirm immutable model tag -> owner
- confirm telemetry dashboards pinned -> owner
- canary policy set -> owner
- SRE smoke run -> owner
- rollback policy tested -> owner
- stakeholder notify -> owner
- freeze merges -> owner
- elevate logging sampling -> owner
- post KPI snapshot -> owner

Notes, tips and common pitfalls (from prior launches)
- Don’t treat token-cost increases as just finance — rapid cost jumps often correlate with an input distribution shift; product QA should sample failing prompts immediately.
- If latency increase appears region-specific, fail traffic back to healthy region rather than immediate global rollback.
- Keep the initial metric set small. Too many signals cause decision paralysis.

Appendix: copy-paste JSON snippet for tracker (example)
{"timestamp":"2024-12-04T14:05Z","rollout_percent":"5","api_p95_ms":"212","error_rate_5xx_pct":"0.07","model_quality_regressions_pct":"0.9","token_cost_per_1k_usd":"0.12","notes":"all green"}

-- end --
